subject: Re: Thursday — Bedford departure
body:
Hi,

Option A works for Alex — let's go with 5:45. Thank you for sorting this out so quickly!

Morgan

> On Tue, Oct 27, Larkhaven Air operations team wrote:
> Here are the options that work:
> A) Depart Bedford at 17:45 (arrive PBI 20:28), same crew. Change fee: $500.
> B) Depart Bedford at 18:00 as requested, and move the morning TEB–BED leg to 08:15. Change fees: $1,000.
> C) Depart Bedford at 18:00 as requested with a different crew taking that leg. Fees: $3,000 total.
> Which would you prefer?
